title: US 80 archive photos

pageHeader.title: US 80 Archive Photos
pageHeader.subTitle: Original freeway prior to expansion projects

text: In July 2024 TxDOT awarded a $580.6 million contract to Austin Bridge and Road for reconstruction and expansion of US 80 from Town East Blvd to east of Belt Line Road, including complete reconstruction of the interchange at Interstate 635. This page includes archive images of that section, showing the original freeway and interchange. A separate project under construction from 2024 to 2027 rebuilt and expanded the freeway at the Trinity River East Fork crossing.

imageStatus.note: The freeway at this location was rebuilt and expanded as part of the interchange replacement at I-635.

images.caption: The four-level interchange at Interstate 635. This interchange opened with the opening of I-635 on Aug 5, 1970. In July 2024 TxDOT awarded a $581 million contract to demolish and rebuild this interchange.
